title: Add interactive demo blocks with Preview/Code tabs and improved discoverability
body:
Documentation lacked interactive examples showing both live component rendering and source code. Added tab-based demo blocks to all component and plugin documentation for easier learning and code adoption. Enhanced discoverability with homepage entry point, navigation link, and comprehensive demos overview page. ## Changes ### New Component - **`InteractiveDemo.tsx`** - Tab-based demo component using Fumadocs UI - Preview tab: live schema rendering - Code tab: formatted JSON with copy button - Supports single or multi-example layouts ### Backward Compatibility - Re-exported `InteractiveDemo` as `ComponentDemo` - all 32+ existing component demos now have tabs - Zero breaking changes to existing MDX files ### Plugin Documentation - Converted 5 plugin docs from `.md` → `.mdx` - Added 14 interactive examples: - **plugin-markdown**: basic formatting, task lists, tables - **plugin-kanban**: board layouts, WIP limits, badges - **plugin-charts**: bar, line, pie visualizations - **plugin-editor**: JavaScript, Python, JSON editors - **plugin-object**: table, form, view components ### Improved Discoverability - **Homepage Entry Point**: Added "✨ Interactive Examples" card in "What Can You Build?" section linking to demos overview - **Navigation Link**: Added "Interactive Component Demos" in Guide sidebar navigation for quick access - **Comprehensive Overview Page**: Created `/docs/guide/interactive-demos` with: - Complete component catalog organized by category (Form, Layout, Overlay, Data Display, Feedback, Disclosure, Complex) - Plugin showcase with feature lists and example counts - Quick start guide for using interactive demos - Technical explanation of how demos work - Links to design resources and next steps - **Keyboard Accessibility**: Added focus-visible styles for keyboard navigation ## Usage ```tsx import { InteractiveDemo } from '@/app/components/InteractiveDemo'; ``` ## Screenshots **Component Demo - Preview Tab** **Component Demo - Code Tab** **Plugin Demo - Markdown** **Plugin Demo - Kanban** **Homepage - Interactive Examples Card** **Interactive Demos Overview Page** ## Technical Notes - Uses Fumadocs UI's `Tabs`, `CodeBlock` components - JSON schemas formatted with syntax highlighting - No new dependencies required - Keyboard accessible with focus-visible styles - All quality checks passed (build, code review, security scan)
Original prompt > 在fumadocs文档中为每一个插件和组件设计功能完整的演示效果，演示效果区块，应该能够很方便的切换查看源码。目标是第一步向潜在开发者展示我们控件强大的能力，方便开发者学习和引用
